<insights>
- The Dayton Dragons are a minor league baseball team based in Dayton, Ohio.
- The Major League Baseball (MLB) team associated with the Dayton Dragons is the Cincinnati Reds.
- The Cincinnati Reds have an eagle on their logo.
- In baseball, the designated hitter (DH) rule applies to the American League (AL). The National League (NL) does not use the DH rule.
</insights>

No, the pitcher does not take a turn at bat in the National League (NL), which is the league associated with the Cincinnati Reds and the Dayton Dragons.
</answer>
